{"people":[{"name":"Tom","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"interviewer","side":"us"},{"name":"Raj","role":"CTO at Marlowe & Finch; ran the RFP; rep's contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"Angela","role":"COO at Marlowe & Finch; signed with Adyen; met once at kickoff","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bev","role":"head of store operations","side":"customer"},{"name":"Ecommerce lead (unnamed)","role":"ecommerce lead who loved the online checkout demo","side":"customer"},{"name":"Solutions engineer (unnamed)","role":"came with Tom to the store ops workshop","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":null,
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Returns. Last holiday season. Buy online, return in store.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Trigger for the evaluation: online-to-store returns during the holiday season."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"The store couldn't see the online order, so staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Concrete failure behind the trigger; store lacked visibility into online orders."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"they'd just launched a loyalty program that was supposed to work everywhere and didn't, because store and web were two different customer records.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Second pain: split customer records broke the new loyalty program."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their COO, Angela, apparently stood in a store on December 27th watching the returns queue.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Hedged hearsay ('apparently'); rep did not witness it. Ties Angela to the trigger."},
{"id":"E5","turn":2,"excerpt":"That's the story everybody there tells.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep's characterization of the customer's shared narrative."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CTO, Raj. He ran the RFP, he was my contact the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"First answer names Raj as final decider; later contradicted."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"He said they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Secondhand from Raj, afterwards; the rep was not there. Competitor brought store-rollout experience."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"And they named retailers Angela knew.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor used references familiar to Angela; relayed by Raj."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Before, it was all web. Conversion, checkout, wallets. After, it was stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Customer question focus shifted from web to stores after meeting the competitor."},
{"id":"E10","turn":8,"excerpt":"Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Hard number: 11 of 14 questions about stores."},
{"id":"E11","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the online checkout demo. Their ecommerce lead loved it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Online checkout demo got the positive reaction."},
{"id":"E12","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the unified commerce part.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Unified commerce pitch got no reaction."},
{"id":"E13","turn":10,"excerpt":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our slide wording that got silence."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"that's a diagram.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Store ops head dismissed the unified commerce slide."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Then she asked how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","label":"fact","speaker":"Bev","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Bev wanted a concrete return walkthrough at the till."},
{"id":"E16","turn":12,"excerpt":"I described it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep described rather than showed the return; later confirmed never demonstrated."},
{"id":"E17","turn":14,"excerpt":"They had six people from store operations. Nobody on our side had run a store rollout.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Store ops workshop: expertise mismatch on our side."},
{"id":"E18","turn":14,"excerpt":"When Bev asked who does the installs, I said we'd bring in a partner. She wrote something down and didn't ask another question.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Install answer relied on a partner; Bev's reaction was muted."},
{"id":"E19","turn":14,"excerpt":"I knew on the drive home.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's own sense of the loss moment: the store ops workshop."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before that, honestly, we were ahead. Raj said so. We'd won the web side.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep says Raj told them we were ahead; web side won."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"Angela's team. Stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"Workshop was requested by Angela's team, not Raj."},
{"id":"E22","turn":18,"excerpt":"Angela.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"id":"E23","turn":20,"excerpt":"Probably Angela. Raj wanted us. I think.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Hedged revision of decider from Raj to Angela."},
{"id":"E24","turn":20,"excerpt":"He told me he did.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Raj's claimed preference for us is only his own statement."},
{"id":"E25","turn":22,"excerpt":"Once. The kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep met the actual signer only once."},
{"id":"E26","turn":24,"excerpt":"A retailer they could call. We sent a case study.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer asked for a reference; we sent only a case study."},
{"id":"E27","turn":24,"excerpt":"can I talk to them?","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Angela wanted a live reference call."},
{"id":"E28","turn":24,"excerpt":"we couldn't set up a call in time.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference call never happened."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"Then a rollout plan. Dates, who installs, what happens to the old tills.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer asked for a rollout plan; no indication one was delivered."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"They wanted to watch an online order get returned at a store till, live. We described it. We never showed it.","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Live return demo requested and never delivered."},
{"id":"E31","turn":26,"excerpt":"\"One system for the tills and the website.\" That was Bev, every time.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Bev's repeated phrasing of the problem."},
{"id":"E32","turn":26,"excerpt":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"Angela's single-accountability concern."},
{"id":"E33","turn":26,"excerpt":"one customer, one basket.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Angela's own phrase for unified commerce."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"They never said 'unified commerce.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer never used our headline term."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"We kept saying 'in-person payments' and 'point of sale.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our own wording for the store side."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"They said 'the tills.'","label":"fact","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's word for store point of sale."},
{"id":"E37","turn":28,"excerpt":"I think we had the better product online. I still think that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"Tom","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","competitor"],"note":"Rep's belief about product strength on web, offered as a closing view."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E6","E22","E23"],"what":"Rep first said CTO Raj made the final call, then said Angela signed with Adyen, then hedged 'Probably Angela'."},
{"evidence":["E6","E21","E25"],"what":"Raj is described as contact the whole way, yet the store workshop came from Angela's team and the rep met Angela only once."},
{"evidence":["E20","E22"],"what":"Rep says we were ahead and had won the web side per Raj, yet the signer chose Adyen; Raj's read did not match the buyer's."},
{"evidence":["E16","E30"],"what":"Rep said 'I described it' to the return question without saying it was never demonstrated; later admits it was never shown."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did you say? (when Bev asked how a return works)","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'I described it' without saying what was said; later admitted never showing it."},
{"question":"So who made the final call?","turn":20,"what":"Hesitated ('...Probably Angela') and fell back on 'I think' and 'He told me he did' after having named Raj."},
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":4,"what":"Gave a role and a reason (ran the RFP, was contact) rather than evidence of who decided; later contradicted."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"One system for the tills and the website","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared","evidence":["E31","E13"]},
{"theirs":"the tills","ours":"in-person payments / point of sale","evidence":["E36","E35"]},
{"theirs":"one customer, one basket","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E33","E34"]},
{"theirs":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other","ours":"partner for installs","evidence":["E32","E18"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E22"],"what":"Lost: Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"evidence":["E20","E11"],"what":"Partial: rep says we had won the web side, but the business went to Adyen."},
{"evidence":["E19","E17","E18"],"what":"Rep places the turning point at the store ops workshop."},
{"evidence":["E28","E30"],"what":"Reference call and live return demo were not delivered before the decision."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep first said CTO Raj made the final call, then said Angela signed with Adyen, then hedged 'Probably Angela'.
Raj is described as contact the whole way, yet the store workshop came from Angela's team and the rep met Angela only once.
